title: Load Trend and History Length in the Annual kWh of Noticed Terminations
content:
> Commercial and Industrial Electricity Contracts: noticed terminations: annual kWh by recent load.

The annual kWh of a noticed termination follow the facility's recent load:

- when 12 or more billed cycles were posted in the twelve months before the handling date, and the kWh posted in the latest three months multiplied by 4 fall below 0.80 of the twelve months' kWh, the annual kWh are the latest three months' kWh multiplied by 4;
- when at least one but fewer than 12 such cycles were posted, they are the twelve months' kWh divided by the cycles counted, multiplied by 12;
- otherwise they are the twelve months' kWh.

## Terms used

- **Billed cycles** are counted once each: by the energy charge line; on a block and index contract, by the block energy charge line, the index energy charge lines then not being counted; otherwise by the index energy charge line.
- **The twelve months' kWh** are the kWh on the contract's supply lines posted in the twelve months before the handling date; **the latest three months' kWh** are those posted in the latest three months. A line falls in the twelve months before the handling date when it was posted on or before the handling date and fewer than twelve whole calendar months have passed from its posted date to the handling date, a month being complete on the same day of the month as the posted date. The latest three months are counted in the same way with three whole months.
- Nothing is rounded here; the annual kWh carry their decimals into the damages kWh.

## Cases (hypothetical)

| Cycles in the twelve months | Twelve months' kWh | Latest three months' kWh, multiplied by 4 | Annual kWh |
|---|---|---|---|
| 12 | 3000000 | 540000, so 2160000, below 0.80 of 3000000 (2400000) | 2160000 |
| 12 | 3000000 | 600000, so 2400000, not below 2400000 | 3000000 |
| 8 | 1840000 | not used | 1840000 divided by 8, multiplied by 12: 2760000 |
| 0 | 0 | not used | 0 |
